cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded my ticket into quarters like you. Much better odds that way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm folding the numbered stubs for the drum. Your ticket stays with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. A compact record of my entry. Which number are you putting in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same number as yours. Keep yours flat so we can match them if you win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then flatten mine before the draw. I intend to be ready when you call my number.

reason: Replace the detached crease joke with a confident directive to the seller caused by the actual matching requirement, turning obedience into asserted preparation for winning.
